'Influence means nothing if you're not using it to make the world a better place'

Donnalyn Bartolome proudly shared her winning moment on the international stage after bagging the prestigious "Best Content Creator" award at the Septimius Awards in Europe.

In her acceptance speech, Donnalyn highlighted the country’s flooding challenges and emphasized that Filipinos hope and continue to push for the government to “do better” with flood control systems.

She also shared how they’ve contributed to the solution, planting trees and bamboo to help mitigate the impact of floods.

“This one is for you, Philippines,” Donnalyn wrote in her caption.

COURTESY: Donnalyn Bartolome/Instagram

Keep your go bag dry, charge phones, and avoid crossing fast water. Mariners along the east coast should expect squalls, gusty winds, and choppy seas.
